title: Nine Letters, and the Words You Already Knew
label: ch:fa-script-nine
canDo: I can write nine Perso-Arabic letters from memory, read salâm, bale, na, mamnun, nân, nâm and mâh off the page rather than from the romanization, and explain why Persian leaves its short vowels unwritten.

payoff.summary: Seven words the book had only ever given by ear, read letter by letter from the right -- and the reason a Persian word can be read only once you have heard it.
